cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - SmallPartsTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
Tray with slants to easier get out game tokens or screws
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SmallPartsTray --two_sided 0 --front_panel 0 --rampheight 1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes SmallPartsTray --two_sided --front_panel --rampheight --reference --labels
